title: Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Peshawar is a city in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa with a population of 2,100,000. One of the oldest cities in South Asia and the gateway to the Khyber Pass, rich in Pashtun culture and history. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. A relatively small share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 270 sunny days a year. The population skews young, with a median age of 23.0.
